metaTitle: Prices today: gold, silver, dollar, crude oil, Sensex and Nifty
metaDescription: Gold (24 and 22 carat) and silver rates from IBJA, the US dollar, Brent crude oil, Sensex, Nifty 50 and Nifty Bank, with how each moved over 1 week, 1 month and 3 months. Every price shows its source and date.
title: Prices today
description: Gold, silver, the dollar, crude oil and the share market. For each price you see the latest value, how it moved over the last 3 months, where it comes from and when.
about_gold24: Rupees for 1 gram of pure gold (999 purity).
about_gold22: Rupees for 1 gram of 22 carat gold (916 purity), the kind most jewellery is made of.
about_silver: Rupees for 1 kilogram of pure silver (999 purity).
about_usdInr: How many rupees 1 US dollar costs.
about_crude: US dollars for 1 barrel (159 litres) of Brent crude oil. India buys most of its oil from abroad, so this price affects what petrol and diesel cost.
about_sensex: Points. It follows 30 big companies on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).
about_nifty: Points. It follows 50 big companies on the National Stock Exchange (NSE).
about_bankNifty: Points. It follows the biggest bank shares on the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

verifyIntro: Every price above has a link to where it comes from. You can also check these sources:
verifyIbja: IBJA (ibjarates.com): gold and silver rates, published on working days. There are no rates on weekends and central government holidays.
verifyRbi: Reserve Bank of India (rbi.org.in): the official reference rate for the US dollar.
verifyYahoo: Yahoo Finance (finance.yahoo.com): the market data we use for the share market, the dollar and crude oil.
verifyCadence: We check the sources about every 15 minutes while Indian markets are open, and about every hour at other times.
noFuel: Petrol and diesel are not shown. Their price is different in every city, and we have not yet found a daily source we can check. We will add them when we do.
notAdvice: These prices are for information only. They are not advice to buy or sell.
